spec.situation_desc: has a card payment they don't recognise
spec.vuln_cue: mentions they're going through a divorce

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Thistle Bank, Zara speaking. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Hi, I’m Niamh Haddad. There’s a card payment I don’t recognise, and honestly I’m fed up with the bank making it so hard to get help.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’m sorry this has been frustrating, Niamh. I can look into it with you. Before we discuss your account, could you confirm your full name and date of birth, please?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thanks. And the first line of your address?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: That’s all verified, thank you. Which payment are you concerned about?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: It’s £186.40 to Northstar Online on the 18th of October. I’ve never bought anything from them.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I understand. I can see the payment you mean. I’ll put a note on the account that you don’t recognise it, and someone will be in touch about the next steps.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: This is the last thing I need right now. I’m going through a divorce as well, and I’ve already spent ages trying to sort this out with you.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’m sorry to hear you’re going through a divorce, Niamh. I’ll make sure the note about the payment is clear.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: So what actually happens now? I don’t want to be left chasing again.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’ll take ownership of this and send you a secure message by 4 pm today confirming that I’ve passed the details on. Someone will be in touch about what happens next, though I can’t give you a timescale for that.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: All right. I just want to know you’ve got the right payment.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Yes, it’s the £186.40 Northstar Online payment dated 18 October. I’ll note that you don’t recognise it, and I’ll message you by 4 pm today to confirm I’ve passed it on. Someone will then be in touch about the next steps, with no timescale I can give you. Does that make sense?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thank you, Niamh. I’m sorry this has been such a frustrating experience. Is there anything else I can help with today?
